determinism: fixed case tables; no random generation

reference_rules.memory: initialized byte buffers and memcpy-based host references
reference_rules.exceptions: no invalid pointers or uninitialized reads

timeout_policy: per-case process timeout 10s; corpus process timeout 120s
performance: exploratory only unless same-host repeated thresholds are frozen before confirmatory measurements

performance_preregistration.suspicion_threshold: Investigate only if the median end-to-end process time of a persistence route exceeds 2.0x the direct route median across the same 256 cases; no single-sample regression claim.
performance_preregistration.limitations: This harness does not instrument MIR construction, interpreter, JIT compile, first call, repeated calls, parse/decode, or worker startup separately. These timings are exploratory end-to-end process measurements.

supplemental_memory_extension.purpose: Increase legal typed memory-form coverage from the initial 13 distinct access tuples to at least 24 after concrete coverage audit.

campaign_outcomes.separate_random_seed_campaign: not run; fixed tables are deterministic and a fresh-process repeat of the complete 412-case corpus was run instead
planned_shortfalls: 20 new opcode target not met (4 new names); memory operand-mode diversity is reported separately and no opcode count was inflated.
No cross-target/QEMU, shared-library, PIE or MIR_object_load execution.
Reducer does not rewrite MIR graph or operation sequences.
